channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
## macOS
- Keeps the dictation pill visible when switching between macOS desktops, displays, and another app's full-screen space. - Preserves the foreground app and paste target while bringing the pill back to the front.
SHA256:
`7ebb62c281898e019ffc43266f60a8aabd219aaec82e840dcb654d669ddf7393 DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`

## macOS
- Copying an image from the Media Library now places the finished composite on the clipboard. - Quick-editor and full-editor arrows, shapes, highlights, masks and other annotation layers are included at the image's native resolution. - The corrected behavior applies both to the viewer's Copy button and to Copy in the library grid.
SHA256: - DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg: 651b641e20dbf1e596401843a3e0fa49b7ae9b7ecb0584076076d95035e74618

## macOS
- `gpt-transcribe` is now the recommended OpenAI model for completed meetings, imported recordings, and chat audio. - Live dictation now has its own selectable `gpt-live-transcribe` model. - Previous GPT-4o, Realtime Whisper, diarization, economical, and Whisper compatibility choices remain available; existing explicit selections are preserved. - Setup packages and the German/English in-app help include the new batch/live model split.
## Windows
- The same `gpt-transcribe` and `gpt-live-transcribe` selections are available for meeting/chat audio and live dictation. - Runtime routing, migration, settings, and German/English in-app help use the same batch/live split. - Previous compatible models remain selectable and existing explicit choices are preserved.
## Verification
- macOS: 210 automated tests, real `gpt-transcribe` SSE request, accepted `gpt-live-transcribe` Realtime session, and Light/Dark UI captures on the Mac Studio. - Windows: 272 automated tests plus Light/Dark UI captures on Grey Iron. - macOS DMG: Developer ID signed, notarized, stapled, and Gatekeeper accepted. - Windows EXE and Setup: Azure Trusted Signing verified with publisher BIK GmbH.
